His raised glove shakes the branch twice, and a few banknotes flutter down slowly and settle in the grass. The mask, gloves and suit stay exactly the same. Background stays the same; nothing new enters the frame. SFX: leaves rustling, paper fluttering. Ambient noise: quiet orchard breeze.
